name: The Office
claim: A whole floor of agents, drawn and moved by one page of QML
body: HAL-C2 runs coding agents in threads. Its Office plugin seats each thread at a desk as a person in a pixel-art office, with the workers it handed work to beside it.
They type, plan at the whiteboard, read at the bookshelves and wait in the break room. When one agent hands work to another, the two walk over and talk.
The page is HAL-C2's own plugin, loaded at run time and running on Ljós as written.

recording.name: office
recording.label: Recording of the Office: people at their desks type and walk over to talk, with speech bubbles, while others wait in the break room.

captures.shows: Hover a person and its thread's card opens
captures.about: Pointer input over a scene drawn on Canvas, with the card bound to the thread's data.

captures.name: office-rooms
captures.alt: The review corner with two reviewers at their desks, and the break room with a sofa, a table and someone walking in.
captures.shows: The review corner and the break room

captures.name: office-desks
captures.alt: Two desk teams at their screens, an exclamation mark over a thread whose last turn failed and a question mark over one asking for an answer.
captures.shows: A failure and a question, at the desk
captures.about: The floor is redrawn from what the plugin publishes. One timer moves everyone, and only while the page is shown.

note: Recorded off-screen on Linux on 2026-11-21, from HAL-C2 at commit 45ae652. The page is HAL-C2's, unchanged. The threads, projects and lines in it are made up for this recording.

engine.name: ljos-play
engine.heading: Built on ljos-play
engine.line: The Office runs on ljos-play, Ljós's game engine for small pixel-art worlds. A world is nested QML objects with bindings; the engine does the clock, the walking and the drawing.
engine.label: ljos-play on GitHub

example.about: Snail Post, one of ljos-play's examples: snails fetch letters, carry them to the boxes, nap under toadstools and stop to gossip.

snippets.says: A Thing stands on tiles and is drawn in art pixels. Its Spots are where snails go to sort the post.
Each snail does the first Activity whose when is true: nap, deliver or fetch.

capture.name: play-snail-post
capture.alt: Snail Post: snails on a lawn under a hedge, some carrying letters from the sorting log to coloured mailboxes, two napping with a z over them.
capture.about: Drawn off-screen by ljos-play's own render task, 30 seconds into the world's time.
